notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 - Beta branch
notes.content:
You can now help with testing Patch 1.1.0 which includes:
- Level Editor.
- "Custom Levels" game mode which allows you to play your levels.
- Boss health bar.


How to play with Beta Patch:
1. Right click on Intrude in your Steam Library and select "Properties".
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25571437/03c4bf8ea1d66831dff849905c85359db63812c2.png[/img]

2. Select Beta tab
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25571437/7dd8df2412977cdb25e1308c6953d159c2126531.png[/img]

3. Here you can switch between Live and Beta version at any time by clicking on the dropdown menu.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25571437/9b268ebb2adc162124b912325be4ac21c2651555.png[/img]

Please report any bugs or other issues [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/495720/discussions/0/350542683188007386/] HERE [/url].
